designs.placementText: It works best on the forearm, one of the easiest spots: low pain and easy to show or cover.

designs.name: Jellyfish lamp
designs.subject: a jellyfish shaped like a hanging lamp
designs.meaning: A jellyfish shaped like a lamp stands for gentle light, calm and finding your glow in dark waters.
designs.styleText: Fine line uses a single thin needle for delicate, sketch-like lines.
designs.aging: Thin lines soften and can spread over the years, so keep the design at least 5 to 7 cm and leave space between details.
designs.placementText: It works best on the forearm, one of the easiest spots: low pain and easy to show or cover.

designs.name: Moon boat
designs.subject: a paper boat sailing on a crescent moon
designs.meaning: A paper boat sailing on the moon is about dreams, journeys and a childlike sense of wonder.
designs.styleText: Minimalist tattoos use only a few clean lines and a lot of open skin.
designs.aging: The fewer lines, the more each one matters: avoid going too tiny, because lines under about 2 cm can blur together.
designs.placementText: It works best on the ankle, a discreet spot for small designs.
